description: Use when you need an x402 endpoint check or x402 endpoint test, or to validate x402 endpoint listings before paying or integrating. Do not use for actually paying the endpoint, or endpoints behind authentication. Returns JSON with an x402 check of an endpoint without paying: whether it answers 402, its payment options (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), Bazaar metadata and problems found for 0.007 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Infrastructure. Price: US$0.007 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

body.description: JSON body to send with POST, e.g. {"url": "https://example.com"} (no payment is ever attached)

method.description: HTTP method of the endpoint (GET when omitted)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://x402.org/protected

name: blackwood_x402_check
title: x402 endpoint check
